title: tc-writing-assistant
description: A compact AI chat card with suggestions, a growing prompt field and dictation.

name.description: The assistant's name, in the header

greeting.description: Big line on the welcome screen

suggestions.description: Chips on the welcome screen; picking one sends it as a message

placeholder.description: Text in the empty prompt field

messages.description: The conversation. Changed by the element unless a tc-messages-change listener calls preventDefault()

draft.description: Text in the prompt field. Changed by the element unless a tc-draft-change listener calls preventDefault()

speech.description: "auto" uses real speech recognition when the browser has it and shows an error otherwise (or plays the sample take with `demo`); "simulate" always plays a sample take

demo.description: Demo mode: the sample writer answers without a warning, and dictation plays the sample take where the browser has no speech recognition
